test_title: PYST 56: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The lions were being fed / by there keeper / when we arrived / at the zoo.
solution:
The correct answer is **"by there keeper"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in **Part(B)/ option 2 **of the sentence.
 
• *There* is used when we have to address some certain location and *their *is used to indicate a noun.
 
• *Their* is the third-person possessive form of *they*.
 
 
• **Example:** They went there for having dinner and these are their dogs.
 
 
 
• The correct answer to this question is "The lions were fed by their keeper when we arrived at the zoo"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The sentence is an assertive sentence of past continuous tense.
 
• Formula Subject + was/were + Verb (+ing)+ (object).
 
 
• **Example: **They were at the dining when the incident took place.
